Āmodarañjana
bibl.note: Raghavan, Venkataraman. Śāhendravilāsa of Śrīdhara Veṅkaṭeśa (A Poem on the Life of King Śāhaji of Tanjore, 1684-1710). Tiruchi: The Kalyan Press, 1952.
A Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (Tanjore). Vols. 1–19.
A Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Adyar Library. Parts 1–2.
A Classified Index to the Sanskrit Mss. In the Palace at Tanjore (Burnell).
The three manuscripts found in vol. 14 of the Descriptive Catalogue of the Sanskrit Manuscripts in the Sarasvati Mahal Library, Tanjore (mss. 8198–8200) are attributed to Kṛṣṇānanda Sarasvatī.

For the name Śivatattvakalikāmodarañjanī, see vol. 14 of the above, ms. 8198. This entry also notes that the author wrote a stotra on Śiva in 100 Vasantatilaka verses and added it to this commentary, explaining the stuti according to Śivādvaita.
